highlights: ANKER Soundcore R50i NC Earbuds 42dB ANC TWS Earphones
Advanced Noise Cancellation: Reduces ambient noise by up to 42dB with Adaptive ANC
High-Quality Sound: Equipped with 10mm drivers and BassUp™ technology for powerful bass and clear treble​
Long Battery Life: Provides up to 10 hours of playback on a single charge, with an additional 30 hours from the charging case​
Durable and Water-Resistant: IPX5 rating ensures resistance to sweat and light rain, suitable for workouts and outdoor use​
User-Friendly Features: Touch controls and the Soundcore app offer 22 EQ presets

Experience the perfect blend of advanced technology, superior sound quality, and exceptional value with the Soundcore R50i NC True Wireless Earbuds by Anker. These earbuds are designed to elevate your audio experience, whether you are listening to music, making calls, or engaging in intense gaming sessions.

Adaptive Active Noise Cancellation (ANC): Equipped with advanced ANC technology, the Soundcore R50i NC reduces ambient noise by up to 42dB, ensuring an immersive listening experience even in noisy environments. The multi-mode ANC adapts to your surroundings, providing optimal noise reduction whether you’re at home, in the office, or on the go​

High-Quality Sound: The earbuds feature 10mm drivers that deliver rich, detailed sound with powerful bass and crisp treble. Anker’s exclusive BassUp™ technology enhances low frequencies, making these earbuds ideal for bass-heavy music genres like hip-hop and electronic dance music​

Extended Battery Life: Enjoy up to 10 hours of continuous playback on a single charge, with the charging case providing an additional 30 hours of power, totaling 40 hours of battery life. This makes the Soundcore R50i NC perfect for long trips and extended use throughout the day​

Durable and Water-Resistant Design: With an IPX5 water resistance rating, the Soundcore R50i NC earbuds are built to withstand sweat and light rain, making them suitable for workouts and outdoor activities. The durable build ensures longevity and reliability under various conditions​
